name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 8 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 8 hours starting 2025-12-14, at wavelengths from 1.04 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
